title: Saeima to review Latvian citizenship grant to Indian scientist
summary_full: The Saeima’s Committee on Citizenship, Migration and Social Cohesion will consider a motion tabled by an unnamed Member of Parliament calling for an investigation into the facts surrounding the granting of Latvian citizenship to Indian scientist Divya Kannan Vishwanath, Latvian Television reported on October 19.
